name: retrace
description: Retrace a finished AI-assisted task and teach it on the spot: the moves the AI made and why, the turning points, the prompts, the mistakes and the cheaper path, saved as a reusable lesson skill.

interface.longDescription: After an AI-assisted task, retrace reads the whole session, saves a lesson skill and teaches it right away: the map, the moves the AI made (what it looked at, what it decided and why), the turning points, the prompts that worked, mistakes and fixes, and the cheaper path next time. Go deeper with a step-by-step walkthrough or a hands-on rebuild, now or later. Lessons stay on your machine.
defaultPrompt: Retrace what we just built and make a lesson
Teach me how we built the checkout flow
Quiz me on the spendsum lesson
